Company seminar and offsite planner

Everything about your company seminar in one place: participants and their replies (pasted from a spreadsheet, reminder flagged after the deadline), who travels with whom on which train, coach or shuttle, who sleeps in which room with automatic allocation that keeps colleagues from the same team together, a programme with parallel workshops and room clashes flagged, and a budget with planned, committed and paid amounts and the cost per participant. Dietary preferences are optional, chosen from a closed list, with a single box for allergies and no medical detail; the caterer only gets numbers, never names.
